title: Coordinated soft-quarantine: regional SLO mediator and tenant circuit braid
author: Anjali Rao
release_notes: Adds a mediating layer to SLO enforcement that coordinates per-region tenant slowdowns and a soft-quarantine circuit braid to reduce oscillation during failovers; includes telemetry and a targeted hotfix for region failover TTL regression.
description: Summary: Implements a lightweight 'SLO mediator' service that sits between the global enforcer and regional routers to coordinate soft-quarantine windows and tenant circuit braided state, preventing rapid reopen flaps during region failover. Motivation: recent incidents showed oscillation when multiple regions reopened simultaneously causing overload and cascade evictions. The mediator introduces short-lived, coordinated windows and a quorum-driven reopen handshake to smooth transitions without hard tenant eviction. Changes: 1) pkg/slo/mediator.go: new mediator implementation with stateful leases, quorum reopen handshake, and exponential reopen backoff per-tenant; 2) pkg/slo/enforcer.go: hooks to consult mediator before applying emergency eviction and a fast-path when mediator unavailable; 3) runtime/router/region_failover.go: integrate mediator calls into regional failover flow and drift-tolerant TTL handling; 4) charts/slo-mediator/: Helm chart + canary config; 5) telemetry/metrics.yaml: added slo_mediator.* counters and histograms and circuit_braid.state gauge; 6) test/fixtures/slo_mediator/: deterministic unit tests and a small harness that simulates cross-region reopen storms; 7) cmd/installer/templates/manifest.yaml: optional mediator sidecar flag for Private installs. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked in Linear ENG-1482 - [x] Unit tests (pkg/slo/*) - [x] Integration smoke harness (simulated cross-region) - [x] Canary Helm chart with probe thresholds - [x] Telemetry and dashboard notes for oncall Runbook notes: When enabling mediator, start in read-only mode (consult-only) for 24h canary, then flip to active for tenants flagged by the rollout list. The mediator exposes debug endpoints to snapshot quorum state and active soft-quarantine windows. Notable fixes: During integration we found a TTL regression in region_failover.go where a reopened region could carry stale lease durations; this PR includes a hotfix that normalizes TTLs against mediator-provided epoch time to eliminate drift. Commits summary: - Add mediator core and tests (Anjali Rao) - Hook mediator into enforcer and router (Anjali Rao) - Helm/chart + installer template (Sofia Alvarez) - Telemetry + dashboards (Kai Nakamura) - Fix TTL drift bug discovered in integration (Anjali Rao) Files changed (high-level): pkg/slo/mediator.go, pkg/slo/mediator_test.go, pkg/slo/enforcer.go, runtime/router/region_failover.go, charts/slo-mediator/values.yaml, telemetry/metrics.yaml, cmd/installer/templates/manifest.yaml Review conversation: Miles Chen: "High level LGTM, please add more assert coverage around quorum failure modes and a comment on the expected lease jitter." Author (Anjali): "Added tests for quorum miss and a code comment describing jitter math; included a small doc note in the chart README." Sofia Alvarez: "Can we gate the mediator rollout by tenant label to keep blast radius small?" Author: "Yes — added a feature flag and per-tenant opt-in list in the Helm chart and installer template." Kai Nakamura: "Telemetry looks good; please ensure the histograms use the standard buckets. Also request a short-run load test on perf-canary." Author: "Adjusted histogram buckets to match platform convention and ran a 30m perf-canary against canary config; results attached in the CI run." Approvals & gating: Miles approved after tests green; Sofia approved after gating flag added. CI summary: linux/build: pass; unit-tests: pass (98% on slo package); integration/smoke: failed initially due to TTL race, fix pushed and rerun: pass; lint: pass; perf-canary: ran 30m canary — stable under 20% extra latency on failover path; e2e: skipped for canary (manual e2e planned during staged rollout). Rollout plan: 1) Deploy mediator in consult-only mode to staging; 2) Canary in us-west-2 for tenants flagged in rollout list (24h); 3) Flip to active for rollout cohort; 4) Expand regionally with 6h observation windows and automated rollback on SLO regressions. Post-merge actions: create dashboards in Grafana team-space (ticket created ENG-1490), update runbook with mediator debug steps, and schedule a 2-hour post-deploy watch. Merge: squashed and merged to main after approvals. Impact: reduces reopen oscillation and emergency eviction churn during multi-region failovers; expected to lower eviction rate by ~35% in simulated reopen storms. Hotfix note: TTL normalization also prevents a class of cross-region lease drift that could have caused persistent false-positive circuit closures. CI artifacts and canary logs are attached to the PR in GitHub.
